Static street hold. Caption clears at 29.4 s revealing the station base with two lit lower pods. The flat brown rectangle on the road is unchanged.

30.0: street station with flooded road and 'More than a half-mile' tag. Cut at 30.2 to an open-country park with fence frames and a tan Hub building. Caption 'In open country, up to five miles, to a hub.'
Faint orange arcs sweep across the sky toward the antenna. A yellow 'Up to five miles in open country' tag lands on the left fence at 31.4.
Near-static open-country hold. Arcs in the sky, antenna tip glowing, tag on the fence, caption persists.
Arcs fade and the caption clears at 33.4. Cut at 33.8 to a desk with a 'Flood spread map' monitor, keyboard, mug and a blue-sleeved arm with a pen. Label 'Not a real hub'.
Desk caption 'At the hub, a second, larger AI maps flood paths for responders.' 'A second, larger model' tag at 34.4 and yellow dots on the line at 34.6. The sleeve slides onto the desk.
35.0: sleeve lies flat on the desk with a dark hand blob and no visible action. 35.2: full-frame monitor close-up. 35.8: orange blobs start spreading from the dots.
Orange flood blobs fill along the map line around the dots, then hold nearly static. Caption unchanged.
'Higher risk' legend and 'For emergency responders' tag drop in. Dashed yellow boxes mark three zones from 37.2. Caption clears at 37.8.
38.0: map monitor. Cut at 38.2 to an olive field with a 'Validation accuracy' card (empty bar) and a cropped 'Field res' card. Caption 'The university reports early chip AI validation.'
Validation bar fills orange from 39.4. '98.82%' appears at 39.8. Static card layout otherwise.
Static hold on the 98.82% card with a full bar. Caption clears at 40.8. No other change.
Static card. Caption 'Accuracy was ninety eight point eight two percent.' at 41.4. Slight zoom in at 41.8.
Card enlarges. 'Initial assessments after training' tag drops under it at 42.4. Caption persists.
Fully static hold of the 98.82% card plus tag and caption across all five samples.
Static, caption cleared. At 44.8 the card shrinks left and a blank-lined 'Field result' card appears. Caption 'The announcement reports no field result.'
Pan right onto the Field result card. A 'None reported' stamp lands at 45.4 and holds.
Static hold on 'Field result / None reported'. Caption clears at 46.6. Nothing else moves.
Cut to a translucent grid sheet on a fence pole, 'Not a real town map'. It turns into an opaque cream town grid with a river line at 47.6. Caption 'It names no town with an installed station.'
Static town grid. A dashed circle flashes at the center (48.4), a faint large ring at 48.6, gone by 48.8.
A dark 'No installation named' tag pins to the top right of the grid at 49.4. Caption clears at 49.8 and the pole base shows.
Cut at 50.2 to a wide park road with the map sheet on the fence at right, label 'No station installed'. Caption 'Deployment is still the goal.' from 50.6.
A dashed vertical line is drawn at 51.2, then a dashed station outline (panel, box, pole) at 51.4. A yellow 'Deployment goal' tag appears at 51.8.
Caption visible only at 52.0. 52.2 to 52.8: static dashed ghost station with tags, no caption.
Completely static ghost-station closing image with no caption. The hold has run about 1.8 s since the last change.
54.0: ghost station. Cut at 54.2 to the dark credits: Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', texasaidocket.com, UT San Antonio Today, September 8th source.
Static credits card identical to 054: flag, Docket title, URL, source, illustration and map lines.
Static credits card unchanged. Dark field, flag, Texas AI Docket title, URL and source lines.
Static credits card, the same Docket card with flag, URL and source lines. No change.
Static credits card identical: Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration and map lines.
Final two frames show the credits card unchanged: flag, Texas AI Docket, URL and source lines.
Tight shot of a pole with four stacked sensor pods over a flooded yard. Caption 'ankle-deep water in their yard' at 0.4. Brown water rises over the lowest pod, which glows orange at 0.8.
1.0: water over the lower pods. Cut at 1.2 to a chain-link fence and tree with an orange post tag. Pull back to 1.8 reveals a house porch edge at left.
Wider yard with porch, fence and tree. A county inset draws the Texas outline top right from 2.2, label 'Map marks the county'. Caption persists.
Caption ends after 3.0. Green lawn chairs on the porch step, brown mud band along the fence base. Texas outline completes by 3.8. No person.
Cut to a dark-screened phone leaning on a white ledge over brown ground. Caption 'UT San Antonio says the phone warning can come after that.'
Phone vibrates at 5.2 (motion marks). A 'Flash Floo[d] Warning / Emergency alert' banner appears with the title truncated. County circle on the map at 5.6.
Static hold on the alert phone. 'Flash Floo' stays truncated, the map circle sits south-central, caption unchanged, nothing moves.
Phone hold continues and the caption clears at 7.4. Cut at 7.8 to the station close-up on a stream bank with solar panel and gauge box.
Station on the stream, then a pull back with caption 'So its researchers built a flood station.' Crane down to the pole base. 'Prototype flood station' callout at 8.6.
Static hold on the park station with its callout, caption over the pole base. Same content as option a over these seconds.
Caption clears at 10.4. The station pole holds a lit lowest pod at its base. Otherwise static.
Close-up on the solar panel and box. Battery meter fills orange to green under a slanted light beam. 'Charges from light' tag. Caption about no cell tower.
